title: Unicode scalar, SHX glyph, and MTEXT layout evidence boundary
mode: deeper and broader research; plan refinement only
scope: Recheck peer Arabic-script text extraction report and independent DXF encoding documentation
Separate file-codec byte/scalar behavior from external font mapping and right-to-left rendering
Review CJK MTEXT width-wrap report against the peer layout helper's documented scope
Audit existing local CP1256 codec anchor and SHAPE identity plan for duplicate work

sources.name: ezdxf issue #1271
sources.observed: The report's author eventually attributes the apparent Persian glyph problem to a custom Unicode-to-Persian glyph mapping; the attached drawing and SHX file were not inspected. The maintainer distinguishes text extraction from unsupported RTL rendering.
sources.limit: Peer report only; not a local reproduction, normative codec rule, or visual oracle.

sources.name: ezdxf DXF file encoding and Unicode decoder documentation
sources.observed: The peer docs describe codepage/CIF transport before R2007, UTF-8 from R2007, and explicit Unicode-escape decoding as a separate step.
sources.limit: Independent implementation documentation, not the normative Autodesk DXF authority.

sources.name: ezdxf font resource documentation
sources.observed: Font files are external resources and rendering depends on resource availability or substitution; Unicode string transport alone does not prove glyph resolution.
sources.limit: Describes ezdxf and does not establish behavior of every CAD consumer.

sources.name: ezdxf issue #1389 and MTextExplode documentation
sources.observed: The peer issue reports CJK no-whitespace wrapping overflow in an MTEXT explode/layout helper and is labeled wontfix; the docs describe the helper as approximate and limited.
sources.limit: Consumer utility issue, not parser/writer behavior or a DXF wire contract.

observed: The existing generated codepage anchor includes ANSI_1256 byte C7 mapping to Unicode U+0627 and reverse encoding.
The existing PAR-05/7AR plan separates source-version/field transport from target-DXF-version byte encoding.
The PAR-90/7AZ plan already keeps SHAPE numeric index, SHAPEFILE identity, and DXF glyph-name alias distinct and does not claim SHX resolution.
libdxfrw text codec is not a bidi shaper, font resolver, or MTEXT line-layout engine.

reuseExistingOwners: Reuse ANSI_1256 byte/scalar and reverse-encode anchors in tests/gbk_codepage_tests.cpp; do not add a duplicate test from the peer report alone.
Keep raw bytes, Unicode scalar sequence, target version/codepage, and UTF-8 validity as separate assertions under PAR-05/7AR.
Keep text-style/font resource mapping separate from legacy T_SHAPE identity under PAR-90/7AZ.
Keep bidi shaping, glyph rendering, CJK line breaking, and MTEXT explode in a consumer-specific optional gate only if required by product claims.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: Do not inspect or redistribute confidential issue attachments; use locally generated text values and no external drawing/font fixture.
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: No tests were run for this plan-only research. For a future leaf, use one focused selector and owning CTest; full suites remain scheduled composed checkpoints.
implementationReadiness.externalJDisposition: All six listed J items remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
